properties.description: Experimental raw Health value from Stable-Retro's data.json. Original Genesis 24-bit work-RAM address 0xFFA216 is converted to RetroArch core_ram offset 0xA216 by subtracting 0xFF0000. Stable-Retro type is >u2. EDAS uses the Sonic 1 Mega Drive compatibility mapping (core_ram, swap16, big-endian) for this ordinary work-RAM field. It has not been tested through RetroTelemetry or EDAS.
properties.notes: Source label: health; Stable-Retro declaration: >u2; validation required for region, revision, byte order and gameplay meaning.

properties.description: Experimental raw Score value from Stable-Retro's data.json. Original Genesis 24-bit work-RAM address 0xFFA212 is converted to RetroArch core_ram offset 0xA212 by subtracting 0xFF0000. Stable-Retro type is >d4. EDAS uses the Sonic 1 Mega Drive compatibility mapping (core_ram, swap16, big-endian) for this ordinary work-RAM field. It has not been tested through RetroTelemetry or EDAS. Stable-Retro declares this as BCD; this entry exposes the raw packed value and must not be treated as a decimal score until runtime decoding is confirmed.
properties.notes: Source label: score; Stable-Retro declaration: >d4; validation required for region, revision, byte order and gameplay meaning.

telemetry_layouts.compatibility_notes: All addresses are imported from the named Stable-Retro Genesis integration and converted from 24-bit work RAM. Runtime verification is required before promotion.

provenance.migration: Experimental definition generated from Stable-Retro integration metadata; no ROM content was downloaded or included.

sources.address_conversion: Stable-Retro Genesis addresses are 24-bit work-RAM addresses in 0xFF0000-0xFFFFFF. RetroArch core_ram offset = address - 0xFF0000. EDAS byte order follows the existing Sonic 1 Mega Drive compatibility mapping: swap16 plus big-endian.
sources.limitations: Stable-Retro integration labels and SHA-1 are useful research evidence, but this definition is not runtime-tested in EDAS. The integration does not record a user-facing region/revision label.
